column1: # What each kanji of the deck words means on its own, for the card line "出 go out + 口 opening".
# The meanings rest on KANJIDIC; where it lacks the sense of the word, on the JMdict entry of that word
# (both: Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group, CC BY-SA 4.0).
# meaning: the sense the kanji has in the deck words, lower case, at most 12 characters.
# basis: the KANJIDIC meaning it rests on, spelt as in KANJIDIC, or "JMdict: " and the word whose JMdict entry gives the sense.
# words: up to three deck words with the kanji. Rows stand in the order of first occurrence in the decks.
# 風呂 is spelt for sound: 風 and 呂 keep their own meanings and do not explain the word.
